ui.acoustid-returns-possible-matches: AcoustID returns possible matches, with raw match scores.
ui.ambiguities-and-album-editions: Ambiguities and album editions are never silently resolved.
ui.approval-needs-a-title: Approval needs a title that agrees, or an artist that agrees together with the same length. A length or an artist name alone is not enough. Contradictions always block approval.
ui.choose-what-meloshelf-decides: Choose what MeloShelf decides on its own. Your own decisions are never overridden.
ui.chromaprint-calculates-a-compact: Chromaprint calculates a compact fingerprint on your device.
ui.duration-and-your-existing: Duration and your existing tags are compared with each candidate. The MeloShelf score is a ranking aid, not a probability.
ui.enter-the-full-path: Enter the full path of a folder on this computer. MeloShelf reads file names and tags without touching the original files. Scanning the same folder again only reads new or changed files.
ui.every-proposal-and-the: Every proposal and the decision you recorded for it. Nothing here changes a file.
ui.find-the-music-behind: Find the music behind the filename
ui.meloshelf-approved-the-recording: MeloShelf approved the recording itself. You can reject it at any time.
ui.meloshelf-score-from-50: MeloShelf score from 50 to 100. Default 80. This is a ranking heuristic, not a probability that the identity is correct.
ui.merges-and-keep-separate: Merges and keep-separate decisions. Each can be undone; undoing leaves the record in place.
ui.musicbrainz-artist-ids-that: MusicBrainz artist IDs that MeloShelf cannot confirm by name alone. Accept one of the offered artists, reject it, or review it later. Your choice is stored apart from the provider's evidence, and undo reverses the last one.
ui.no-candidate-was-supported: No candidate was supported well enough to propose.
ui.photographs-are-fetched-only: Photographs are fetched only for artists whose identity is verified, and from openly licensed images on Wikimedia Commons first; optional sources you switch on in Settings are only a fallback and always show their source. Each shows its author, licence and source. You can choose your own image, remove one, or undo your change. Nothing is written to your music files.
ui.results-are-proposals-never: Results are proposals, never automatically verified album editions. Files that already have a result are not analysed again.
ui.spellings-and-collaborations-that: Spellings and collaborations that MeloShelf grouped under one artist. Your original tags are never rewritten.
ui.the-evidence-is-ambiguous: The evidence is ambiguous, conflicting or too weak to decide automatically.
ui.this-phase-supports-review: This phase supports review decisions only. Changes to audio tags and file locations are not enabled.
ui.title: Title
ui.when-on-a-recording: When on, a recording whose MeloShelf score reaches the threshold and agrees with your tags is approved without asking. The album edition is never chosen automatically.
ui.when-two-candidates-are: When two candidates are similarly supported, keep the file in the review queue. When off, it is left unidentified rather than queued.
ui.you-rejected-this-proposal: You rejected this proposal. MeloShelf will not approve it automatically.

org.setup.fpcalc_help: Chromaprint is a free tool that listens to a song to identify it. Without it MeloShelf still organizes music whose tags are reliable; everything else goes to review. Download the Windows zip from the official page, unzip it into C:\Tools\chromaprint, then choose Check again: no restart needed.
